description: Finds professionals currently employed at startups to recruit using apidojo's Twitter scrapers on Apify. Triggers when the user asks to: find startup employees to recruit on Twitter, discover people working at early-stage startups for talent poaching, find employees at Series A or B companies on X who might be open to new roles, identify talent at competitor startups via Twitter, build a talent map of startup employees in a sector on Twitter, find people with startup experience for recruiting, or discover potential candidates at named startup companies. Returns handle, name, current company (from bio), role level, follower count, and career change signals. Ideal for technical recruiters, startup talent leads, and VC-backed company HR teams.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
